import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    # Remove only the sketches added by the previous mistaken placement.
    original_names = {
        'mx_plate_gasket v1': 'LEFT_PLATE_SURFACE',
        'mx_plate_right_tb_gasket v1': 'RIGHT_TB_PLATE_SURFACE',
    }
    restored = []
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        doc = app.documents.item(i)
        if doc.name not in original_names:
            continue
        des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if des is None:
            continue
        root = des.rootComponent
        removed = 0
        for j in range(root.sketches.count - 1, -1, -1):
            sk = root.sketches.item(j)
            if sk.name == original_names[doc.name]:
                if sk.deleteMe():
                    removed += 1
        restored.append({'document': doc.name, 'removed_sketches': removed, 'remaining_sketches': root.sketches.count})

    targets = [
        ('sage60_left_plate_surface', '/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate/gasket_v1/mx_plate_gasket.dxf', 'LEFT_PLATE_SURFACE'),
        ('sage60_right_tb_plate_surface', '/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate_right_tb/gasket_v1/mx_plate_right_tb_gasket.dxf', 'RIGHT_TB_PLATE_SURFACE'),
    ]
    created = []
    for doc_name, path, sketch_name in targets:
        doc = app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType)
        doc.name = doc_name
        des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        root = des.rootComponent
        before = root.sketches.count
        im = app.importManager
        opts = im.createDXF2DImportOptions(path, root.xYConstructionPlane)
        imported = bool(im.importToTarget(opts, root))
        added = []
        for j in range(before, root.sketches.count):
            sk = root.sketches.item(j)
            sk.name = sketch_name if j == before else sketch_name + '_' + str(j - before + 1)
            sk.isVisible = True
            added.append({'name': sk.name, 'lines': sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines.count, 'arcs': sk.sketchCurves.sketchArcs.count, 'circles': sk.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.count, 'profiles': sk.profiles.count})
        app.activeViewport.fit()
        created.append({'document': doc.name, 'imported': imported, 'bodies': [b.name for b in root.bRepBodies], 'sketches': added, 'isSaved': bool(doc.isSaved)})
    print(json.dumps({'restored_originals': restored, 'created_new_documents': created}, ensure_ascii=False))
